newsitem.title: CANADA: Renaissance Energy plans share issue.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance Energy plans share issue.

text.p: Renaissance Energy Ltd said on Thursday it planned to offer eight million shares in a fully marketed issue.
Renaissance said it retained a group of Canadian investment dealers to form a syndicate for the offering, expected in the next three weeks.
The company said it intended to use the proceeds to expand its capital spending in the fourth quarter and in 1997.
It said its initial capital budget for 1997 was set at C$800 million.
The company expected to drill a total of 1,700 wells in 1996, up from an original estimate of 1,500, it said.
Renaissance also said it expected to drill 1,850 wells in 1997.
It said it expected the current industry environment would continue into next year, making for opportune investing in various projects and property acquisitions.
